description: Align the four Drosophila PTHR43802 paralogs to the 2DUB structure sequence and read residues at the catalytic and oxyanion-hole positions
code:
import requests, os
import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
H={"User-Agent":"curation-agent/1.0"}; OUT="/tmp/srlp"; os.makedirs(OUT,exist_ok=True)
r=requests.get("https://files.rcsb.org/download/2DUB.pdb",headers=H,timeout=180); open(f"{OUT}/2DUB.pdb","wb").write(r.content)
T2O={'ALA':'A','ARG':'R','ASN':'N','ASP':'D','CYS':'C','GLN':'Q','GLU':'E','GLY':'G','HIS':'H','ILE':'I',
'LEU':'L','LYS':'K','MET':'M','PHE':'F','PRO':'P','SER':'S','THR':'T','TRP':'W','TYR':'Y','VAL':'V','MSE':'M'}
res={}
for l in open(f"{OUT}/2DUB.pdb"):
    if l[:6]=="ATOM  " and l[21]=="A" and l[12:16].strip()=="CA" and l[17:20].strip() in T2O and l[16] in " A":
        res[int(l[22:26])]=T2O[l[17:20].strip()]
rk=sorted(res); rseq2="".join(res[k] for k in rk)
print("2DUB chainA observed:",rk[0],"-",rk[-1],"n=",len(rk))
print("  resseq144 =",res[144],"  resseq164 =",res[164],"  resseq141 =",res[141],"  resseq98 =",res[98])
print("  context 138-148:","".join(res.get(i,'-') for i in range(138,149)))
print("  context 158-168:","".join(res.get(i,'-') for i in range(158,169)))

b62txt="""A R N D C Q E G H I L K M F P S T W Y V
A 4 -1 -2 -2 0 -1 -1 0 -2 -1 -1 -1 -1 -2 -1 1 0 -3 -2 0
R -1 5 0 -2 -3 1 0 -2 0 -3 -2 2 -1 -3 -2 -1 -1 -3 -2 -3
N -2 0 6 1 -3 0 0 0 1 -3 -3 0 -2 -3 -2 1 0 -4 -2 -3
D -2 -2 1 6 -3 0 2 -1 -1 -3 -4 -1 -3 -3 -1 0 -1 -4 -3 -3
C 0 -3 -3 -3 9 -3 -4 -3 -3 -1 -1 -3 -1 -2 -3 -1 -1 -2 -2 -1
Q -1 1 0 0 -3 5 2 -2 0 -3 -2 1 0 -3 -1 0 -1 -2 -1 -2
E -1 0 0 2 -4 2 5 -2 0 -3 -3 1 -2 -3 -1 0 -1 -3 -2 -2
G 0 -2 0 -1 -3 -2 -2 6 -2 -4 -4 -2 -3 -3 -2 0 -2 -2 -3 -3
H -2 0 1 -1 -3 0 0 -2 8 -3 -3 -1 -2 -1 -2 -1 -2 -2 2 -3
I -1 -3 -3 -3 -1 -3 -3 -4 -3 4 2 -3 1 0 -3 -2 -1 -3 -1 3
L -1 -2 -3 -4 -1 -2 -3 -4 -3 2 4 -2 2 0 -3 -2 -1 -2 -1 1
K -1 2 0 -1 -3 1 1 -2 -1 -3 -2 5 -1 -3 -1 0 -1 -3 -2 -2
M -1 -1 -2 -3 -1 0 -2 -3 -2 1 2 -1 5 0 -2 -1 -1 -1 -1 1
F -2 -3 -3 -3 -2 -3 -3 -3 -1 0 0 -3 0 6 -4 -2 -2 1 3 -1
P -1 -2 -2 -1 -3 -1 -1 -2 -2 -3 -3 -1 -2 -4 7 -1 -1 -4 -3 -2
S 1 -1 1 0 -1 0 0 0 -1 -2 -2 0 -1 -2 -1 4 1 -3 -2 -2
T 0 -1 0 -1 -1 -1 -1 -2 -2 -1 -1 -1 -1 -2 -1 1 5 -2 -2 0
W -3 -3 -4 -4 -2 -2 -3 -2 -2 -3 -2 -3 -1 1 -4 -3 -2 11 2 -3
Y -2 -2 -2 -3 -2 -1 -2 -3 2 -1 -1 -2 -1 3 -3 -2 -2 2 7 -1
V 0 -3 -3 -3 -1 -2 -2 -3 -3 3 1 -2 1 -1 -2 -2 0 -3 -1 4"""
L=b62txt.split("\n")[0].split(); B62={}
for ln in b62txt.split("\n")[1:]:
    p=ln.split(); B62.update({(p[0],L[i]):int(v) for i,v in enumerate(p[1:])})
def nw(s1,s2,go=-11,ge=-1):
    n,m=len(s1),len(s2); NEG=-1e9
    M=np.full((n+1,m+1),NEG); X=np.full((n+1,m+1),NEG); Y=np.full((n+1,m+1),NEG)
    PM=np.zeros((n+1,m+1),int); PX=np.zeros((n+1,m+1),int); PY=np.zeros((n+1,m+1),int)
    M[0,0]=0
    for i in range(1,n+1): X[i,0]=go+ge*(i-1); PX[i,0]=1
    for j in range(1,m+1): Y[0,j]=go+ge*(j-1); PY[0,j]=2
    for i in range(1,n+1):
        for j in range(1,m+1):
            s=B62.get((s1[i-1],s2[j-1]),-4)
            c=[M[i-1,j-1],X[i-1,j-1],Y[i-1,j-1]]; k=int(np.argmax(c)); M[i,j]=c[k]+s; PM[i,j]=k
            c=[M[i-1,j]+go,X[i-1,j]+ge,Y[i-1,j]+go]; k=int(np.argmax(c)); X[i,j]=c[k]; PX[i,j]=k
            c=[M[i,j-1]+go,X[i,j-1]+go,Y[i,j-1]+ge]; k=int(np.argmax(c)); Y[i,j]=c[k]; PY[i,j]=k
    i,j=n,m; st=int(np.argmax([M[n,m],X[n,m],Y[n,m]])); pr=[]
    while i>0 or j>0:
        if st==0: pr.append((i-1,j-1)); st=PM[i,j]; i-=1; j-=1
        elif st==1: st=PX[i,j]; i-=1
        else: st=PY[i,j]; j-=1
    return pr[::-1]

def fa(a): return "".join(requests.get(f"https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/{a}.fasta",timeout=120).text.split("\n")[1:])
flies={"Q9VG69":"Srlp (CG5844)","Q7K0K7":"CG4860-like","Q0IGX9":"paralog Q0IGX9","Q9VB17":"paralog Q9VB17"}
TARGET={144:"base (Glu144)",164:"acid (Glu164)",141:"oxyanion Gly141",98:"oxyanion Ala98",142:"Gly142"}
print("\n=== fly PTHR43802 paralogs aligned to 2DUB chain A ===")
tab={}
for a,lab in flies.items():
    s=fa(a); pr=nw(rseq2,s)
    m={rk[i]:(j+1,s[j]) for i,j in pr}
    ident=sum(1 for i,j in pr if rseq2[i]==s[j])/len(pr)*100
    row={}
    for t,tl in TARGET.items():
        row[t]=m.get(t,(None,"-"))
    tab[a]=row
    print(f"\n {a} {lab}   aligned {len(pr)} cols, {ident:.1f}% id to rat ECH")
    for t,tl in TARGET.items():
        p,c=row[t]; print(f"    rat {res[t]}{t:<4d} {tl:18s} -> {c}{p if p else ''}")

fig,ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(8.6,3.4))
order=["Q9VG69","Q7K0K7","Q0IGX9","Q9VB17"]
cols=[144,164,141,142,98]
names=["base\nGlu144","acid\nGlu164","oxyanion\nGly141","Gly142","oxyanion\nAla98"]
M=np.zeros((len(order),len(cols)))
for i,a in enumerate(order):
    for jj,t in enumerate(cols):
        c=tab[a][t][1]
        M[i,jj]= 2 if c==res[t] else (1 if (c in "DE" and res[t] in "DE") else 0)
ax.imshow(M,cmap="RdYlGn",vmin=0,vmax=2,aspect="auto")
for i,a in enumerate(order):
    for jj,t in enumerate(cols):
        p,c=tab[a][t]; ax.text(jj,i,f"{c}{p if p else ''}",ha="center",va="center",fontsize=10,fontweight="bold")
ax.set_xticks(range(len(cols))); ax.set_xticklabels(names,fontsize=9)
ax.set_yticks(range(len(order))); ax.set_yticklabels([f"{a}\n{flies[a].split('(')[0]}" for a in order],fontsize=8)
ax.set_title("All four Drosophila PTHR43802 members lack the catalytic acid (rat Glu164)",fontsize=10.5)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
